answer: The tide counter is kept in dune and vertex makes public each reset. A bond is refunded only after 40 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An copycat thus has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 40 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 4460 identities would post 2982 proofs and burn roughly 53 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
